description: Register a company (developer, platform, or retirement broker) as a Gigaverse integration partner. Returns a partner_id immediately (status pending_review). That id cannot be used on start_signup until it is approved in Mission Control (https://mc.trydragonfly.com). Repeating the same company, website domain, or email returns the existing partner_id and sends no email. Website is required and must resolve in DNS. No API secrets are issued pre-RIA.

email.description: Business contact email on a real domain

sandbox.description: true = test mode: returns a test- partner_id, stores nothing
